name: Layered Ishizukibase
description: Stand with the blade angled forward and the shaft slanted so the guard can turn to either side.

name: Ruthless Harai
description: Sweep the edge upward from the low side with qi pressed into the curve to lift the foe's guard.

name: Dire Habakiring
description: Drag the blade toward the body across the foe's forearm as the rear hand pulls the shaft back.

name: Dire Nagaheel
description: Thrust the point level with the foe's forearm to pin the arm before it can raise a weapon.

name: Stalwart Sayacap
description: Slide the open lead palm along the shaft to meet a blow and shed it down the wood.

name: Haraihurdle
description: Cross the rear foot in front of the lead foot to gain a pace without lowering the blade.

name: Lurching Tsubaring
description: Surge qi down the shaft at the instant of the sweep so the cut flies a hand's breadth past the steel.

name: Nagascreen
description: Wind the shaft around the foe's weapon in a tight turn and hold it fast with steady qi in the wood.

name: Stubborn Nagablade
description: Grip the shaft just above the blade root and sink the weight so the guard stays small and tight.

name: Harsh Bladecurve
description: Hack with the thick base of the edge against a foe pressing too close to take the full curve.

name: Lurching Ishizuki
description: Run the rear hand up the haft as the point enters the gap beside the foe's shield arm.

name: Ishiprop
description: Catch a descending blade in the angle between the edge and the shaft and twist it away.

name: Sukuiflog
description: Anchor qi in the blade root and chop the heel of the edge through a guard that holds the shaft short.

name: Stubborn Ishizuki
description: Turn the whole shaft in one spin from a planted stance and throw the pressing weapon wide with qi.

name: Ishibuckle
description: Start the shaft turning at the wrist so a ring of wood and steel crosses the front of the body.

name: Doughty Sukui
description: Roll the wrists over at the top of a spin so the edge falls onto the foe's guard hand.

name: Sunethwack
description: Pass the blade beneath the lead arm and reverse it outward to cut the foe's near flank.

name: Rude Kake
description: Throw the blade back over the shoulder and slash at a foe who circles behind the guard.

name: Nagabuckle
description: Spin the shaft against the direction of the incoming cut and carry that blow off the line.

name: Sukuistalk
description: Pivot on the lead foot while the shaft turns so the body slips inside the foe's swing.

name: Viselike Nagashaft
description: Beat the butt of the shaft against the foe's hands to jar the weapon loose from its line.

name: Buttressed Nagatip
description: Wheel the haft in a steady ring with qi in the spin so the ring stops cuts and thrusts alike.

name: Ishizukibase Swat
description: Let the stored spin fly out into one long sweep that carries the force of every turn before it.

name: Lassoing Uchiotoshi
description: Wind the haft through the foe's guard in a loop and trap both his hands against his own weapon.

name: Sleet Habakiring
description: Hold the shaft steady and let a thread of qi trace the curve of the blade from root to tip.

name: Nagaflog
description: Slide the curve along the foe's body so the edge cuts for the whole length of the stroke.

name: Statickake
description: Whip the very tip of the blade across the face with a snap of both wrists.

name: Rillsune
description: Tilt the flat of the curve against the attack and let the foe's weapon skid off its slope.

name: Gritnagi
description: Step sideways in a low glide so the foe's weapon only brushes past the shoulder.

name: Clay Nagi
description: Push qi to the very tip so the cutting line extends beyond the steel through the foe's guard.

name: Clay Sayacap
description: Draw the curved edge across the foe's torso with qi heaped along the arc to open a long wound.

name: Sprigishi
description: Wait in a low open guard with the blade trailing so a sweep can leap up from any side.

name: Honedharai
description: Take the foe's blow on the shaft and let the same motion carry the edge back across his side.

name: Wild Harai
description: Cut the outer flank of a foe who rushes past and has left his back half open.

name: Clay Nagablade
description: Press the blade down onto the foe's rising weapon again and again so it never lifts.

name: Bladecurve Buckle
description: Tap twice on the foe's weapon with the shaft to draw a flinch before the real cut.

name: Rillsukui
description: Step back out of a thrust and sweep the blade into the foe's extended arm.

name: Raw Uchiotoshi
description: Send qi through the shaft on the instant a parry lands and sweep back before the foe can reset.

name: Rill Tsubaring
description: Throw the incoming weapon over the shaft with a flick of qi and turn the blade to face the opening.

name: Brawn Kake
description: Drop the whole stance and sweep at the legs with heavy qi as the foe's attack spends itself.

name: Regimen Nagaheel
description: Hold the shaft loosely in the rear hand so the grip can run forward or back with the stroke.

name: Gleamsukui
description: Let the shaft slip through the lead hand as the point drives out a hand farther than expected.

name: Brutal Nagatip
description: Pull the grip back mid-stroke so the curve hooks round the guard and bites the far side.

name: Bladecurve Hasp
description: Slide both hands back to the middle of the shaft to bring the blade home to guard.

name: Rill Mawashi
description: Change the grip and the lead foot together so the reach of the weapon changes with the step.

name: Discord Habakiring
description: Jam the shaft hard against the foe's lead hand so his grip cannot slide.

name: Vicious Harai
description: Run the grip to the very butt and swing the edge at the longest reach with qi along the shaft.

name: Honed Nagi
description: Snap both hands forward along the shaft at once and pierce armor seams with focused qi at the point.

name: Sleet Nagashaft
description: Stand square with the blade raised and the shaft ready to go out and come back along one line.

name: Crimson Ishizukibase
description: Fling the edge out to the full length of the arms across the foe's lead hand.

name: Ember Mawashi
description: Bring the blade back toward the body on the same line so the curve cuts a second time.

name: Ishizuki Buckle
description: Finish the return stroke with the shaft crossed in front of the chest to stop the answering blow.

name: Ruthless Kake
description: Weave outward and inward cuts together with a steady flow of qi so the foe sees no gap.

name: Nagiprop
description: Beat the foe's weapon aside with a qi-laden stroke of the shaft and leave the guard open.

name: Nagaprop
description: Hold the blade point-up with the back of the curve facing the foe ready for a hooking pull.

name: Humnaga
description: Catch the blade back behind the foe's collar and haul him forward off his balance.

name: Crimson Mawashi
description: Cut the exposed flank in the same breath that a hook has dragged the guard aside.

name: Draught Sukui
description: Rap the unsharpened back of the blade across the knuckles to make the foe drop his grip.

name: Nagibuckle
description: Hook the curve behind the foe's lead calf and pull so the leg is swept out from under him.

name: Clay Tsubaring
description: Release the hook and step out of reach at once so the foe cannot grasp the blade.

name: Entangling Nagaheel
description: Hook the foe's weapon and drag it along the ground with steady qi so he cannot free it.

name: Hum Uchiotoshi
description: Spin the hooked limb with a surge of qi in the shaft and throw the foe flat on his back.

name: Static Nagi
description: Pull the foe's guard wide with the hook and cut through the gap in the same stroke.

name: Armored Nagablade
description: Plant the stance wide and hold the shaft so still that a blow cannot move it.

name: Hungry Sayacap
description: Drop the edge down a perfectly vertical line from overhead onto the foe's lead shoulder.

name: Savage Nagashaft
description: Hold the shaft level and push the point out along a line that never wavers.

name: Buttressed Nagashaft
description: Drive the butt cap into the ground and brace the shaft against it to take a heavy blow.

name: Prowling Uchiotoshi
description: Settle the whole weight onto the planted foot after each step so the stance never floats.

name: Hum Nagablade
description: Meet a striking weapon with a rigid qi-braced shaft and let the rebound throw it back.

name: Momentnaga
description: Lean the full weight along the shaft onto the foe's crossed weapon until his arms buckle.
